sources: https://alberobello.com/en/visit-alberobello/countryside/bosco-selva-alberobello (official tourism site: freely accessible 24 hours a day, about 2 km from the centre, 45 ha)
leads.why_lead: Public wood with real paths, but no source names an individual old tree, no register row, no coordinate for one. A wood is not a collectible point (avenue or wood: blocked as a unit). If someone finds a named veteran inside it, it is a candidate.
